title: Packaging and transfer trials
description: Optional. Defaults retain three packaging measurements and the aligned one-or-10 transfer rule.

fields.label: Phase 2 packaging runs
fields.help: Fixed repetitions of serialization/compression; does not repeat AE training.

fields.label: Phase 2 maximum transfer trials
fields.help: Total trials including the first when it meets the cutoff.

fields.label: Phase 2 first-transfer cutoff (seconds)
fields.help: If the first transfer exceeds this duration, stop after one trial.

fields.label: Phase 6 maximum transfer trials
fields.help: Total trials per prepared package; failure retries are separate.

fields.label: Phase 6 first-transfer cutoff (seconds)
fields.help: For each transport, use send time on a clean first trial or full elapsed time if it required a retry.

title: Model training and utility evaluation
description: Optional. Choose CPU or GPU execution and control training cost. Larger batches and GPU precision can change reconstruction quality; compare the results.

fields.label: AE compute device
fields.help: GPU requires compatible CUDA and CuPy on the pipeline host. Unavailable GPUs fail explicitly.

fields.label: AE batch size (rows)
fields.help: Try 4096 for GPU experiments. Larger batches reduce optimizer steps per epoch and may need a different epoch budget; check reconstruction quality.

fields.label: AE CPU thread limit
fields.help: 0 uses library defaults. Applies to CPU training; more threads may not help small networks.

fields.label: AE progress interval (epochs)
fields.help: Logs epoch, loss, elapsed time and rough time remaining to the maximum epoch budget.

fields.label: AE loss improvement tolerance
fields.help: Absolute training-loss improvement required to reset the patience counter.

fields.label: AE patience (epochs)
fields.help: Training stops after more than this many consecutive epochs of insufficient improvement.

fields.label: Random seed
fields.help: Used for reproducible model fitting and sampling.

fields.label: Maximum patients for distance evaluation
fields.help: Samples distinct patients for distance and neighbourhood comparisons.

fields.label: Neighbour counts
fields.help: Comma-separated positive counts. Include 5 because final TOPSIS uses top-5 overlap.

title: Feature-selection rules
description: Optional. Review correlation deletion and protected columns before changing them.

fields.label: Missingness cutoffs (%)
fields.help: Comma-separated hourly missingness cutoffs. Clinical-only runs use the highest cutoff.

fields.label: Correlation cutoff (%)
fields.help: Absolute Pearson correlation; used by Phases 1 and 3.

fields.label: Phase 1 correlation cutoff override (%)
fields.help: Leave blank to use the shared correlation cutoff.

fields.label: Correlated-field action
fields.help: Flag retains both fields; drop enables supported automatic removal, respecting protected fields.

fields.label: Minimum paired observations
fields.help: Minimum observation support before correlated fields may be removed.

fields.label: Minimum paired patients
fields.help: Minimum patient support before correlated fields may be removed.

fields.label: Additional protected clinical columns
fields.help: Comma-separated column names. Blank means no additional clinical columns; structural protections remain.

title: Delivery timing scenarios
description: Optional. These settings determine which preparation costs enter the delivery comparison.

fields.label: Delivery scenarios
fields.help: Select at least one. Existing payload excludes initial preparation costs from its score; it does not skip experimental training.

fields.label: Assumed model reuse count
fields.help: Fresh-data scoring divides training cost by this count. Use more than 1 only when reuse is part of the experiment.

title: Simulation settings
description: Optional; used only for simulated transfer timings.

fields.label: Simulated bandwidth (Mbps)
fields.help: Idealized bandwidth, not measured SSH throughput.

title: Decision eligibility and sensitivity
description: Optional. Blank limits apply no extra gate; these are experimental limits, not clinical safety standards.

fields.label: Minimum predictor retention (%)
fields.help: Require at least this share of original eligible predictor columns for loss-tolerant rankings.

fields.label: Minimum observed-measurement retention (%)
fields.help: Require at least this share of the original non-missing measurements.

fields.label: Maximum new clinical-screen violations (%)
fields.help: Exclude candidates above this rate in loss-tolerant rankings.

fields.label: Clinical-screen sensitivity cutoffs (%)
fields.help: Comma-separated cutoffs for the sensitivity report. Blank disables this optional report.

title: Additional SSH recovery settings
description: Optional. These supplement the destination, port, maximum attempts and transfer deadline above.

fields.label: Initial retry delay (seconds)
fields.help: Exponential backoff between transient failures; zero disables waiting.

fields.label: Connection timeout (seconds)
fields.help: Deadline for establishing an SSH connection.

fields.label: Remote command timeout (seconds)
fields.help: Deadline for setup, checksumming and publication commands.

fields.label: Keepalive interval (seconds)
fields.help: Interval between SSH keepalive messages.

fields.label: Missed keepalives before disconnect
fields.help: Unanswered messages allowed before the connection is considered lost.

title: Execution behaviour
description: Optional. Independent failures remain recorded in the final report.

fields.label: Continue independent configurations after a failure
fields.help: Allow other Phase 4/6 configurations to finish when one fails.
